description: This file defines the main App component for a React frontend application. It includes a custom hook to detect viewport size and conditionally renders either an overlay message for non-desktop views or the routes for the main application.

methods.name: useIsBelowDesktopBreakpoint
methods.description: A custom hook that detects if the current viewport width is below a specified breakpoint (default 1024px) and updates reactively on resize events.

methods.name: DesktopOnlyOverlay
methods.description: A React functional component that renders an overlay informing users that the application is restricted to desktop viewports.

methods.name: App
methods.description: The main root component that conditionally renders the overlay or the application's routes based on viewport size.
